thread:
Nora: heads-up — Prospect Solace wants a private deployment before quarter end. SLA ask: 99.9% uptime + p95 <150ms for chat. They also require KMS + HSM option, 1yr audit logs, and a staged canary. Need product/eng/runtime/infra/security to agree on scope and handoffs.

Calvin: I can own capacity sizing + rollout runbook. need traffic profile: steady qps, burst characteristics, and typical prompt sizes to pick pooling strategy.

Mei: runtime note: median prompt ~130 tokens, tails hit ~850 tokens. steady qps ~90, onboarding bursts ~420 for a few minutes. batching and kv-cache prefetch will be key. fallback model for tail requests ok up to 0.5% if documented.

Arjun: infra: we can provision dedicated nodes in customer VPC and support private control plane. main decision: prewarmed nodes vs fast attach standby. cost delta is nontrivial. what's runtime's cold-start tolerance?

Helena: security checklist: KMS/HSM, VPC peering, SAML/SCIM, audit retention mapping. Legal requires PII handling plan for 1yr retention. threat model required prior to granting private control-plane creds.

Nora: draft rollout idea:
- Contract gating: SLO appendix + privacy addendum signed
- Staging validation: perf + security (7-10 days)
- Canary: 5% traffic -> 25% over 72h with observability/alerts
- Full ramp with rollback gates and a 7-day hold period

Calvin: infra asks: estimate cost for 0/2/6 prewarm node configurations by EOD Wed. reserve staging cluster "solace-stg-1760" (4 prewarm) if billing ok. also automation: fast-attach flow for standby nodes (P1).

Mei: runtime deliverables:
- perf matrix for candidate model variants (tonight)
- required prewarm SLA (e.g., <12s cold-start) for infra to meet p95
- test plan for fallback variant and kv-prefetch behavior

Helena: security deliverables:
- KMS integration plan + owner (Helena)
- draft log retention + PII redaction plan for legal (Helena + Legal)
- threat model doc by next Tue

Arjun: created placeholder staging cluster and allocated 4 prewarm slots, pending billing. will post cost delta numbers tomorrow.

deploy-bot: staging cluster "solace-stg-1760" created by Arjun at 2025-01-10T10:12:00Z  4 prewarm slots allocated.

Nora: ok owns: Nora (PM), Calvin (infra sizing/rollout), Mei (runtime/perf), Helena (security). please drop a 3-bullet checklist in this thread by EOD tomorrow so i can consolidate and share with Solace.

Mei: will upload perf matrix later tonight. initial hypothesis: quantized variant + 8 GPUs + continuous batching hits steady p95; bursts need small prewarm buffer or faster attach.

Calvin: noted. i'll include attach time targets in the cost spec.

Helena: pinging legal for PII guidance: @legal can you advise whether 1yr audit retention triggers extra controls for finance/healthcare customers?

Nora: thanks team. if any blocker (policy/billing/infra) surfaces, flag immediately. planning a 15-min sync tomorrow if checklists posted. :calendar:
